figures.caption: Fig. 1: Schematic workflow of the computational methodology. The process begins with the structural relaxation of the bulk electrode and electrolyte materials using both DFT and uMLIPs. These relaxed bulk structures are cleaved to form stable slabs, which are subsequently stacked using the Zur and McGill lattice matching algorithm [44] to create interfaces. Finally, the thermodynamic, mechanical, and kinetic properties of the relaxed interface structures are evaluated.

figures.caption: Fig. 4: Comparison of lithium-ion kinetics across six solid-solid battery interfaces using various uMLIPs. a Arrhenius plots of the total Li-ion diffusivity, log10 D, against 1000/T, predicted by Allegro, MACE, NequIP, PET, Orb and UMA at 600, 700, 800 and 900 K; lines are least-squares fits for each model. The models were evaluated on the most stable Miller index configurations for each of the interfaces: Li2O/Li, Li2S/Li, LiCl/Li, β-Li3PO4/Li, γ-Li3PO4/Li, and LiPON/Li. b Activation energy (Ea) from the slope of each fit in a, for each interface and model. The PET (PET-OAM-XL checkpoint) results for Li2O/Li, Li2S/Li and LiPON/Li (open symbols, dotted fits) come from simulations with Li– Li collapse or energy drift (Figures S52 and S53) and should be read with caution.

figures.caption: Fig. 5: Effect of the fine-tuning dataset on model performance compared to the pre-trained model. To systematically analyze the influence of training data, we fine-tuned MACE-MP-0a(medium) models on three different datasets: exclusively on slabs, exclusively on interfaces, and on all interface and slab configurations of the LiPON(100)/Li(210) interface (large crosses). The pre-trained and fine-tuned models are compared with DFT through a the Einterface error (logarithmic axis), b the force MAE of the interface structures, and the signed errors (MLIP −DFT) in c Ef and d Wadh. The octagons, thin diamonds and hexagons are the three Li Miller indices (100), (111) and (221) not included in the fine- tuning data. As this figure shows a single model and a single chemistry, its markers are tints and shades of the LiPON/Li color.
